findings.highlight: They killed and exterminated each other
findings.evidenceJa: 殺し尽くし、殲滅しあった彼らの戦い
findings.governingReading: The two fight through repeated killing and mutual annihilation until the red knight alone disappears.
findings.explanation: Killed each other conventionally asserts both combatants died, obscuring Berserker’s continuing restoration.

findings.highlight: Many walls have been knocked down
findings.evidenceJa: 壁は何重と穿たれている
findings.governingReading: The hall’s walls have been bored through in layer after layer.
findings.explanation: Knocked down changes repeated penetrations through walls into the collapse of multiple walls.

findings.highlight: it has also destroyed time
findings.evidenceJa: 時間さえかしいでいる
findings.governingReading: The scale of ruin metaphorically makes even time seem tilted because the hall no longer recalls its appearance two hours earlier.
findings.explanation: Destroyed time literalizes and intensifies the metaphor into temporal destruction.

findings.highlight: both his legs are almost melted. broken down.
findings.evidenceJa: 両足は崩壊しかけている
findings.governingReading: Both of Berserker’s legs are on the verge of structural collapse.
findings.explanation: The English prints two competing renderings consecutively, one of which invents melting.

findings.highlight: he is slashed from his shoulder to his groin
findings.evidenceJa: 肩から股下までを貫かれている
findings.governingReading: A wound pierces Berserker through from shoulder to below the crotch.
findings.explanation: Slashed changes a penetrating wound into a surface cut.

findings.highlight: his internal organs can be seen at his stomach. there is a hole bored into his stomach.
findings.evidenceJa: 腹には空洞が穿たれている
findings.governingReading: A cavity has been bored into Berserker’s abdomen.
findings.explanation: The English first inserts exposed internal organs, then prints a second competing translation of the same wound.

findings.highlight: ended much earlier
findings.evidenceJa: 半刻で決着がついていた
findings.governingReading: The battle itself was decided within the stated span of half a koku.
findings.explanation: Much earlier removes the explicit duration needed to distinguish the fight from the hall’s two-hour visual comparison.

findings.highlight: Getting defeated six times
findings.evidenceJa: 六回もやられる
findings.governingReading: Illya rages that Archer took Berserker down six times, consuming six restorations.
findings.explanation: Defeated can describe one overall loss and weakens the repeated lethal outcomes that determine his remaining lives.

findings.highlight: a fatal blow
findings.evidenceJa: 致命傷に近い純度の一撃
findings.governingReading: Archer delivers six distinct attacks of a purity approaching a fatal wound.
findings.explanation: Fatal removes the source’s near-fatal qualification.

findings.highlight: fully healed within few minutes
findings.evidenceJa: あと数分で完治
findings.governingReading: Nonfatal wounds will finish healing within a few minutes.
findings.explanation: The missing article makes the duration phrase ungrammatical.

findings.highlight: Butrestoring everything
findings.evidenceJa: だが全てを元に戻すには
findings.governingReading: Restoring everything, unlike nonfatal wounds, requires three days.
findings.explanation: But and restoring are fused at the recovery-time distinction.

findings.highlight: rape toy with them
findings.evidenceJa: 弄ぶなり
findings.governingReading: Illya gives Berserker leave to kill Rin and Saber or toy with them as he likes.
findings.explanation: The English prints rape immediately before toy with as competing debris, adding an explicit sexual act and corrupting the sentence.

findings.highlight: can’t kill Saber’s Master quickly
findings.evidenceJa: 簡単に殺しちゃダメ
findings.governingReading: Illya orders Berserker not to kill Shirou easily because she intends to give him the worst death.
findings.explanation: Quickly again changes ease into speed and weakens her intention to make his death especially difficult and cruel.

findings.highlight: Smiling
findings.evidenceJa: くすり、と愉しげに笑って
findings.governingReading: Illya leaves the castle with a small, delighted laugh at the death she plans for Shirou.
findings.explanation: Smiling omits both the audible laugh and her explicit enjoyment.

findings.highlight: it’s fine that I shared my magical energy with Saber
findings.evidenceJa: なんでか知らないが、廃墟から追い出された
findings.governingReading: Shirou says he does not know why Rin drove him out, then reports her explanation about adjustments and changing clothes.
findings.explanation: The English inserts a direct description of sharing magical energy with Saber before the source states only his puzzled expulsion.

findings.highlight: The sky in the east is getting redder
findings.evidenceJa: 東の空にはかすかに赤みが差して
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese page contains only Shirou’s silence; the dawn-sky narration is commented out.
findings.explanation: mirror moon restores deleted narration that fixes his gaze and the dawn’s visual progression.

findings.highlight: submerged in thoughts of her sensations. memories of Saber.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの記憶に浸っていたら
findings.governingReading: Shirou says dwelling in Saber’s memories will get him killed and would be disrespectful to her.
findings.explanation: The English restores the deleted sensations reading and prints it alongside the active memories wording as competing variants.

findings.highlight: I made love to contact with Saber to save her
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーを助ける為に触れ合った
findings.governingReading: Shirou says the physical union or contact occurred to save Saber.
findings.explanation: Made love to contact prints incompatible alternatives in one malformed phrase.

findings.highlight: No matter how soft Saber is and how good it felt
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーが柔らかくて
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese moves from Shirou denying other feelings directly to calling himself a liar; the softness and pleasure line is commented out.
findings.explanation: mirror moon restores deleted erotic reflection and leaves its sentence unfinished.

findings.highlight: I can’t forget Saber’s sensations. But I have to forget about them for now. the spectacle I saw inside Saber. But I have to forget about it for now.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの中で見た光景が忘れられない
findings.governingReading: Shirou cannot forget the scene he saw within Saber, but must set it aside to face Berserker.
findings.explanation: The English restores the deleted tactile version, then prints the active vision version and repeats the transition as an ungrammatical fragment.

findings.highlight: Whether I’m able to face Saber like I did before after something like that. act normally
findings.evidenceJa: 自然な素振りができるか
findings.governingReading: Shirou worries whether he can behave naturally toward Saber after glimpsing her heart.
findings.explanation: The English prints two alternative renderings consecutively, leaving the sentence malformed.

findings.highlight: YYeah, I’ll go right away
findings.evidenceJa: あああ、いま行く
findings.governingReading: Shirou stammers that he is coming while trying to conceal his blush.
findings.explanation: YYeah is a visible typographical corruption rather than a controlled stammer.

findings.highlight: kill him in one blow
findings.evidenceJa: 一撃で首を落とす
findings.governingReading: Rin says a successful ambush absolutely requires taking Berserker’s head in one blow before he can counterattack.
findings.explanation: Kill him generalizes the concrete decapitation condition and obscures the planned wound.

findings.highlight: do so outside of battle
findings.evidenceJa: 打ち合いの外から決す
findings.governingReading: Saber says Berserker must be decided by a strike outside the normal exchange of blows.
findings.explanation: Outside of battle suggests defeating him without combat at all and obscures the tactical contrast with trading blows.

findings.highlight: the best suited for this role
findings.evidenceJa: 一番動きやすい
findings.governingReading: Rin argues that she has the greatest freedom of movement among the three.
findings.explanation: Best suited broadens a concrete mobility advantage into overall fitness for the role.

findings.highlight: With the amount of magical energy Shirou gave me, I have now
findings.evidenceJa: 今の魔力では
findings.governingReading: Saber refers only to her present magical-energy level.
findings.explanation: The English inserts a discarded-looking clause asserting that Shirou supplied the energy, then continues with the active rendering.

findings.highlight: I will no longer be able to maintain my body the instant I use my Noble Phantasm
findings.evidenceJa: おそらく使った瞬間に体を維持できなくなる
findings.governingReading: Saber judges that she would probably become unable to maintain her body the instant she used the Noble Phantasm.
findings.explanation: The English removes probably and turns her prognosis into certainty.

findings.highlight: it will not be full force
findings.evidenceJa: 純度は落ちています
findings.governingReading: The Noble Phantasm’s purity has fallen with Saber’s depleted magical energy.
findings.explanation: Full force replaces the stated purity measure with generic effort or power.

findings.highlight: I wouldn’t be much help
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの足をひっぱる
findings.governingReading: Rin says even her intervention would hinder Saber against Berserker.
findings.explanation: Wouldn’t be much help weakens active interference into low usefulness.

findings.highlight: I would have no intention of doing that even if she didn’t tell me to be there
findings.evidenceJa: 言われなくてもそんな気は毛頭なかった
findings.governingReading: Although staying away may be wiser, Shirou has absolutely no intention of doing so even if told.
findings.explanation: The English changes defiance of an order to withdraw into persistence if no one invites him to participate.

findings.highlight: I hold up the branch
findings.evidenceJa: 木の枝を手に取る
findings.governingReading: Shirou picks up the branch he gathered to begin working on it.
findings.explanation: Hold up invents a display gesture instead of taking the material in hand.

findings.highlight: until it becomes a real one
findings.evidenceJa: きちんとしたモノに仕上げれば
findings.governingReading: Repeated reinforcement must finish the branch into a sound, functional object.
findings.explanation: A real one suggests authentic replication, conflicting with the later admission that the bow looks nothing like Archer’s.

findings.highlight: the concept of creation
findings.evidenceJa: 創造された理念
findings.governingReading: Shirou must begin his imagining from the ideal or concept embodied in the created bow.
findings.explanation: Concept of creation turns the object’s created ideal into an abstract concept about the process of creating.

findings.highlight: formulate every hypothesis
findings.evidenceJa: あらゆる想定をしなければ
findings.governingReading: To approach the genuine bow, Shirou must mentally envision every possible aspect or condition.
findings.explanation: Formulate every hypothesis recasts constructive visualization as speculative theory-building.

findings.highlight: The branch is shaped right
findings.evidenceJa: とりあえず形にはなっていた
findings.governingReading: The branch has at least taken a recognizable form, though the result immediately proves ugly and unlike the model.
findings.explanation: Shaped right asserts correctness and removes the tentative minimum success.

findings.highlight: it’s enough for now
findings.evidenceJa: 今はいいわ
findings.governingReading: Rin decides to leave her interrupted concern aside for the moment because they have gained a method.
findings.explanation: It’s enough evaluates the attack method as sufficient rather than marking her deliberate deferral.

findings.highlight: a normal magic
findings.evidenceJa: 生半可な魔術
findings.governingReading: Saber warns that half-measure or insufficiently powerful Magecraft cannot reach Berserker.
findings.explanation: Normal magic changes inadequate execution into an ordinary category and collapses Magecraft terminology.

findings.highlight: I seeif it is the magic from that time
findings.evidenceJa: そうかあの時の魔術ならば
findings.governingReading: Saber recognizes that the spell Rin used then would penetrate Berserker.
findings.explanation: See and if are fused.

findings.highlight: will penetrate him without any problems
findings.evidenceJa: 問題なく貫通する
findings.governingReading: An A-ranked magical attack will penetrate Berserker without difficulty.
findings.explanation: The English line lacks its closing punctuation.
